ABOUT US

A Decoration Company Built on Craft and Trust

Thani Building Decor is a professional full interior and exterior decorator serving residential and commercial clients across Nigeria. From homes and offices to shops and hotels, we deliver quality finishing and beautiful decorative solutions that turn ordinary spaces into extraordinary ones.

Our motto says it all: we deliver to get another job and referral. Every project we take on is treated as a showcase of our skill, our care, and our commitment to excellence.

  • Homes, offices, shops and hotels
  • Residential and commercial projects
  • Quality workmanship on every job
  • Customer satisfaction guaranteed

OUR SERVICES

Everything Your Space Needs, Done Right

From walls to floors and ceilings to curtains — we handle every detail of your interior and exterior decoration.

🎨

Painting

Smooth, flawless paint finishes for interior and exterior walls using quality paints and expert application techniques.

🔧

Screeding

Professional floor screeding for a perfectly level, durable surface ready for any flooring type.

✦

Wallpaper Installation

Clean, seamless wallpaper fitting in a wide range of textures, patterns and styles to suit your taste.

▦

Fluted Panel Installation

Modern fluted wall panels that add depth, texture and a premium feel to living rooms, offices and feature walls.

▤

Vinyl / SPC Flooring

Durable, water-resistant vinyl and SPC flooring in wood, stone and tile effects for any room.

◈

3D Wall Panels

Striking three-dimensional wall panels that create bold visual impact and a contemporary design statement.

✧

POP Designs

Custom plaster-of-Paris ceiling and wall designs — from simple borders to elaborate suspended ceilings.

◇

Decorative Wall Designs

Hand-crafted decorative wall finishes including stencilling, texture coatings and artistic murals.

◆

Marble Boards

Elegant marble-effect board panels for feature walls, TV backdrops and accent surfaces.

📷

Decorative Painting

Specialist decorative paint techniques including sponging, rag-rolling and faux finishes for unique surfaces.

☼

Window Blinds

Supply and installation of roller, venetian, vertical and roman blinds tailored to your windows and style.

✦

Decorative Curtains

Custom curtain selection and hanging — from sheer voiles to heavy drapes — finished to a professional standard.

▰

Full Interior Decoration

Complete interior decoration packages covering walls, floors, ceilings, soft furnishings and finishing touches.

⌂

Exterior Decoration

Professional exterior painting, cladding and finishing to boost kerb appeal and protect your building.
